title: Provisioning visibility: post stage updates to #eng-infra (bot messages w/ links)
creator: Vanessa Ortiz
project: Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
description:
Problem
Operators and oncall folks currently learn about provisioning progress from a mix of CLI output, control plane logs, and ad-hoc pings. During pilots we’ve had multiple “is it stuck?” moments, plus slow MTTR when a stage fails because the next person doesn’t have the right links.

Goal
Automatically post provisioning status updates into #eng-infra with:
- Stage transitions (Requested → Provisioning → Imaging → Bootstrapping → Validating → Ready/Failed)
- Per-stage durations + overall elapsed time
- Deep links to relevant UIs/logs/runbooks
- A clean threading model to avoid channel spam

Scope
- Slack notifications for provisioning runs (new pool bring-up + pool expansion runs).
- Message templates for:
  1) Run started
  2) Stage started
  3) Stage finished
  4) Run completed (Ready)
  5) Run failed (with error category + next steps)
- Links included (where available):
  - Control plane run status page (or API link if UI not ready)
  - Time-to-ready dashboard filtered by pool_id/run_id
  - Logs search link filtered by correlation_id
  - Relevant runbook section for the failing stage

Non-goals
- Paging policy changes (handled under SRE alerting tickets).
- Replacing existing dashboards; this is a “push” layer on top of metrics/events.

Design notes
- Consumption model: provisioning service emits structured stage events w/ correlation_id; bot subscribes (queue/event stream) and posts to Slack.
- Threading: one parent message per run in #eng-infra; subsequent stage updates are replies in the thread.
- Noise control:
  - Default: post only stage transitions + completion/failure (no per-node spam).
  - Coalesce “rapid” transitions: if stage start+finish happen within <30s, post a single combined update.
  - Dedup: idempotency key = run_id + stage + event_type + attempt.
- Failure message requirements:
  - Clear error classification (e.g., DNS/TLS, GPU health, IAM/quota, Helm/values, perf-canary)
  - Include “what to do next” bullets and the escalation owner.

Acceptance criteria
- For a staging provisioning run:
  - A parent message appears in #eng-infra with pool_id, region, sku, run_id, initiator, and overall status.
  - Each stage transition appears in the same thread with stage duration + cumulative elapsed.
  - On failure, message includes error category + direct links to logs/dashboard/runbook.
  - No duplicate updates for the same stage event (verify by replays/retries).
  - Message volume is bounded (<= 1 parent + <= 2 msgs per stage + completion/failure).

Implementation tasks
- Add/extend Slack notifier consumer in incident-bot (or shared notifier) to accept provisioning stage events.
- Add Slack Block Kit templates:
  - Header: “Dedicated provisioning run” + status pill
  - Fields: customer/pool, region, sku, stage, attempt, elapsed
  - Links: status, dashboard, logs, runbook
- Add mapping from error codes/categories (from provisioning events) → runbook anchors.
- Add configuration:
  - Channel IDs (staging vs prod), gated behind provisioning feature flag
  - Optional override to route failures to a separate channel (future)
- Test plan:
  - Unit tests for message rendering + dedup
  - Staging dry-run that replays a historical run’s event stream to validate threading and ordering

References
- Slack: #eng-infra kickoff + pilots (see sprint threads)
- Confluence: Provision-to-ready automation overview
- Dashboard spec: Dedicated readiness dashboard
- Related PRs (expected): incident-bot template update + provisioning service event emitter
comments: 2024-02-22 (Vanessa Ortiz): Please thread these updates. We don’t want #eng-infra to become a firehose when imaging retries. Parent message per run + replies for stages seems best.

2024-02-23 (Aisha Bello): Make sure we include a link to the time-to-ready dashboard filtered by pool_id/run_id. If that’s not possible yet, include the metrics query string we can paste into Grafana.

2024-02-26 (Rafael Mendes): For failures, include the error category (DNS/TLS vs IAM/quota vs GPU health vs Helm) and link to the right runbook section. This will cut down on pinging infra-oncall for basic triage.

2024-02-27 (Gabe Wilson): Proposed idempotency key: {run_id, stage, event_type, attempt}. We’re seeing event replays during consumer restarts; dedup is required or we’ll spam. Also adding a 30s coalesce window for start+finish.
2024-03-01 (Allison Grant): Please include correlation_id in the Slack message and ensure it matches the structured event field (not the request_id). That’s what our log search links will filter on.

2024-03-04 (Harish Reddy): Operator POV: include the CLI command to re-run the failed stage (if available) as a small snippet in the failure message. Even just `rw provision rerun --run-id … --stage validating` is helpful.

2024-03-06 (Gabe Wilson): Implemented in incident-bot with Block Kit templates + threading. Staging channel is #eng-infra-staging; prod channel #eng-infra. Dedup + coalesce added. PRs up: incident-bot template + control plane emitter wiring.
2024-03-08 (Connor O'Brien): During rollout, can we gate on the provisioning feature flag? We should avoid posting for legacy/manual expansions until we’re confident the event stream is complete.

2024-03-12 (Vanessa Ortiz): Verified on staging pilot run: parent message created, stage replies threaded, Ready posted with total elapsed. Injected a Helm values failure and got the correct runbook link + log query. Marking done.
